purpose: Teach: 裏面/デタラメ/マズイ/酔っ払い/いまひとつ/合掌/かみさん/無茶苦茶

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがメッセージカードの裏面に絵を描かれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad drew a picture on the back of that message card.
lines.style: Soft, noticing tone. Speaking to a child with gentle warmth. Unhurried pacing. A small smile in the voice—sharing something tender that pleased her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、デタラメな事は言わないって誓うよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I promise I don't make things up.
lines.style: Serious and solemn, the way a six-year-old can be. Direct, no performance. A small vow spoken quietly, with the weight of meaning to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの料理がマズイって仰った事ないわ
lines.en: Sho, you've never once said your dad's cooking was bad.
lines.style: Warm recognition. A slight lift at the end—pleased by his loyalty. Speaking with tenderness, the tone of someone noticing something good about him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、酔っ払いの真似はしないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I don't copy him when he's drunk.
lines.style: Firm for his age. A child protecting someone he loves without being asked. Quiet conviction. The words come out steady and true.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きがいまひとつ上手くいかなかったの
lines.en: Sho, my drawing didn't turn out quite right.
lines.style: Thoughtful, a little self-deprecating. Reflective pause before the complaint. Speaking as if thinking aloud to someone she trusts. Soft acceptance of imperfection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、神社で合掌したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I prayed for you at the shrine.
lines.style: Eager, small and genuine. A child offering something he thinks matters. No self-consciousness. The words tumble out with quiet joy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがママをかみさんって冗談で呼んだのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad called your mom 'the missus' as a joke.
lines.style: Wry, with an undercurrent of affection. A slight laugh in the delivery. Light touch on the absurdity. Speaking as if sharing something both funny and human.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、無茶苦茶な要求はお父さんにしないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I don't ask Dad for anything unreasonable.
lines.style: Soft but certain. The closing pledge of a child who understands loyalty. Deliberate, with a sense of finality. Spoken with quiet pride in his own restraint.
